detailed_description:
The target video is a 7-second cinematic live-action xianxia scene in true Eastern classical realism: real skin texture, real worn fabrics, film-grade depth of field, natural motivated lighting, and a low-saturation cold grey-blue palette (青灰/月白/黛青) with a single dim warm accent from the oil lamp. No subtitles or on-screen text of any kind appear.
[Shot 1] The scene opens at 0.0 s on a medium shot at eye level inside <Subject 2>, the dilapidated earthen hut at night. <Subject 1>, Chen Xiang exactly as in <Picture 1> — messy black topknot with loose strands, patched slate-blue frog-button tunic — stands motionless before the low dark couch (卧榻)， quietly listening to a truth spoken by someone off-screen. The earthen wall, torn yellow talisman papers, cracked clay jar with dried herbs, and the warm orange glow of the oil lamp at lower right are visible in the dim environment; faint cold light seeps through the broken hole in the wall, wrapping the scene in an oppressive cold-grey tone. The camera performs a slow, steady push-in toward his face. Around 2.5 s his composed expression shatters in an instant: his pupils contract sharply, his eyes lock hard onto the direction of the couch, and his whole body goes rigid and still. The push-in settles firmly on his stunned, shocked eyes as the shot ends at 4.0 s.
[Shot 2] At 4.0 s, a single hard cut to an extreme close-up at eye level of <Subject 1>'s eyes, directly continuing from Shot 1's landing point. The camera is essentially static with only micro-stability. Disbelief takes over: the rims of his eyes quickly redden, tears well up and tremble but never fall. His gaze quivers slightly yet never looks away, all grief and indignation freezing in his reddened, tear-glistening eyes; a faint warm reflection of the oil lamp shimmers in his irises against the cold ambient light. The final frames rest on his brimming, sorrowful gaze as the video ends at 7.0 s.
